links.comparator_used: Unwatermarked LLM/VLM output (same models without watermarking), across 5 watermarking schemes, 11 LLMs and 7 VLMs on medical tasks
links.outcome: Medical reasoning quality, terminological precision, and induced hallucinations in watermarked versus unwatermarked generation
links.effect: Watermarking can induce substantial degradation across multiple failure modes; no numeric effect sizes given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Watermark-induced lexical corruption, hallucinated terminology, and amplified misattribution or omission of image findings; aggregate metrics and general benchmarks can mask these failures
links.quote: Our results reveal that watermarking can induce substantial degradation across multiple failure modes, including lexical corruption, hallucinated terminology, and amplified misattribution or omission of image findings.
